entries.versionBasis: GitHub release release-49 of unicode-org/cldr, published 2026-10-21; calendar types per the CLDR Islamic calendar design.

licence.basis: unicode.org/license.txt (Unicode License v3) covers CLDR data files (read 2026-11-11).

norn.overlap: Hijri calendar display: islamic-umalqura, islamic-civil, islamic-tbla, islamic-rgsa

priority.reason: Hijri (Umm al-Qura) display beside Gregorian; storage stays ISO 8601.

entries.notes: Umm al-Qura is the Saudi administrative calendar (computed, deterministic); sighting-based dates (islamic-rgsa) are not computable in advance, so religious holidays stay observed data. Storage stays ISO 8601.
